WITH result AS (
    INSERT INTO contacts (business_id, phone, display_name, source)
    SELECT b.id, $1, $2, 'whatsapp'
    FROM businesses b
    WHERE (regexp_replace(b.whatsapp_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = regexp_replace(split_part($3, '@', 1), '[^0-9]', '', 'g') OR b.waha_session_name = $3)
      AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
    ON CONFLICT (business_id, phone)
    DO UPDATE SET display_name = EXCLUDED.display_name, updated_at = NOW(), last_seen_at = NOW()
    RETURNING id, business_id, phone
)
SELECT r.id, r.business_id, r.phone, b.waha_session_name
FROM result r
JOIN businesses b ON b.id = r.business_id;

INSERT INTO conversations (business_id, contact_id, channel, status, last_message_at)
SELECT business_id, id, 'whatsapp', 'active', NOW()
FROM contacts
WHERE id = $1::uuid
ON CONFLICT (contact_id, channel)
DO UPDATE SET last_message_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, business_id;

UPDATE conversations
SET last_message_at = NOW(), updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = $1
RETURNING id;

WITH target AS (
    SELECT cv.id AS conversation_id
    FROM contacts c
    JOIN conversations cv ON cv.contact_id = c.id AND cv.channel = 'whatsapp'
    WHERE c.phone = $1
    ORDER BY cv.last_message_at DESC NULLS LAST
    LIMIT 1
),
echo AS (
    SELECT EXISTS(
        SELECT 1
        FROM messages m
        WHERE m.conversation_id = (SELECT conversation_id FROM target)
          AND m.direction = 'outgoing'
          AND m.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '15 minutes'
          AND length($2) > 0
          AND lower(regexp_replace(coalesce(m.text_body, ''), '[^a-zA-Z0-9]+', '', 'g')) = $2
    ) AS is_echo
),
own AS (
    SELECT EXISTS(
        SELECT 1 FROM businesses b
        WHERE regexp_replace(b.whatsapp_phone, '[^0-9]', '', 'g') = regexp_replace($1, '[^0-9]', '', 'g')
          AND b.deleted_at IS NULL
    ) AS is_own_number
)
SELECT own.is_own_number, echo.is_echo, (own.is_own_number OR echo.is_echo) AS should_block
FROM own CROSS JOIN echo;
